Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. West Indies have totally annihilated India in the shortest format of the game and they will be really happy with their performance today. India on the other hand will look to brush this defeat aside as they head back home. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. Until next time, cheers and take care!

West Indies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite says that he is very very happy with the outcome. Informs that he has given a captain's incentive as whoever scores a fifty, he gets half of his match fees. Says that experience from the Indian T20 League has helped them and they knew how good Bhuvneshwar Kumar is at the back end and so wanted to bowl him as much as possible in the initial overs. Praises Lewis' knock and says that he played a magnificent innings. Also applauds Kesrick Williams, who carried his momentum from the previous series against Afghanistan.

Man of the Match, Evin Lewis says that it was a good game. Adds that he enjoys playing against a team like India. Reckons that it were the ODI failures which were on the back of his mind. Mentions that it is always a pleasure to have Chris Gayle at the other side as it relieves pressure off him. Ends by saying that he will look to perform well in the future as well.

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that they could have added 25-30 runs extra. They were on track for a 220-plus score. Also ruins the dropped chances. Mentions that after giving a good start, one batsman had to bat through but failed to do so. Praises Karthik for his knock in the middle but reckons no one posted a big score. Feels that such matches are a good test and they have to be patient with the new guys. Adds that West Indies have a settled squad and they are an experienced side as well. Overall he feels that the tour has been a positive one, they lost just one ODI and a lone T20I. Ends by saying that they enjoy coming here and that they will leave on a happy note.

Evin Lewis did get company in Gayle and Samuels but they looked like standbys throughout the chase. None of the Indian bowlers troubled them. Kuldeep Yadav got a wicket but he went for plenty as well. The visitors will look to put this defeat to bed as they head to their next conquest in Sri Lanka. We have the presentation coming up for you shortly...

The tourists tried everything but it was Evin Lewis who had different plans altogether. Outscoring Gayle is difficult they say but this lad did that in some style. He got a couple of reprieves but except that it was just some sensational power hitting. Evin went on to score the highest score by any batsmen in a T20I during a chase which just speaks volume of his innings.

West Indies have totally decimated the hosts and hunted the 191-run target in some style. After opting to bowl first, they were highly confident of chasing the target down and just proved that. India batted well and posted a competitive total on the board thanks to some fantastic batting by their openers and Karthik. But when they stepped out to bowl, things changed completely.

SIX! Lewis has won it in the fashion it deserves. He kneels down and slog sweeps the fuller ball around leg over backward square leg. And when he hits, it stays hit. Goes into the stands and the hosts register a thumping victory. WEST INDIES WIN BY 9 WICKETS AND 9 BALLS TO SPARE!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Slightly shorter, Samuels goes back and thumps it in the mid-wicket region. Goes on couple of bounces across the fence for a boundary.
Leg bye! Angling into the pads, Samuels fails to put bat on it. Gets it off the pads on the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Wide yorker, Samuels fails to squeeze it out on the off side.
Angling into the batsman, Samuels looks to heave it across but the ball sneaks through.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Banged in short, Samuels lets it sail through to the keeper.
100-run stand between Evin Lewis and Marlon Samuels!
FOUR! Well placed! On a length outside off, Samuels cleverly waits for it and glides it through the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is brought into the attack. 13 runs needed off 18 balls.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Lewis kneels down and slog sweeps it over backward square leg for a single.

SIX! Back-to-back! This time even bigger! Full outside off, Lewis just clobbers it over long off. It's another maximum and it's his 11th one of the game. He now equals the record of highest number of maximums in a T20I game by a West Indian.
SIX! Into the stands! Full outside off, Lewis stays in the crease and tonks it straight over the bowler's head for a biggie.

Huge shout for lbw! Full on middle and off, spinning in a touch. Lewis gets across to play but swings and misses. Gets rapped low on the pads and the players start appealing. The umpire however, stays unmoved. Dhoni and Jadeja can't believe it.
Sliding away from the batsman, he leaves it alone.
Short outside off, punched through cover-point for a single. 27 needed off 24 now!
FOUR! Shortish delivery outside off, Lewis stands tall and punches it over extra cover. In the gap again and another boundary.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.

Four leg byes! A chance missed! Served slightly shorter outside off, spinning in. Samuels who has advanced down the track gets done in by the length. Misses it completely and the ball brushes the pads. The deflection takes Dhoni off guard and a stumping chance goes begging. The ball runs towards the third man fence. Four leg byes signalled.
FOUR! Typical Samuels! He dances down the track and lofts it inside out over extra cover. Gets it in the gap and picks up another boundary.
Lewis stays back and punches it through covers for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav is back on.
Full outside off, pushed to covers with the top hand coming off.
2nd T20I century for Evin Lewis. Both of them have come against India.

Take a bow, Evin Lewis! Back-to-back T20I tons against India. Coming to the ball, it was on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a single. 42 needed off 31 now. Lewis now needs to keeps his calm and take his side across the finish line.
SIX! Moves to 99! Fired outside off at 103 kph. Lewis lofts it handsomely over long off for half a dozen. He is playing with so much confidence and at utmost ease.
Guided to short third man. Dot ball.

SIX! No stopping Lewis today! Full in the line of the stumps, Lewis tonks it over the bowler's head. Doesn't even bother looking at the ball as he knows it's good enough to clear the fence. This guy is playing an unbelievable knock!
Slants it across Lewis. He puts his bat to it but gets beaten.
Wide! Lewis gets across, kneels down to slog it on the leg side but misses. A wide is signalled as it's down the leg side.

FOUR! Edge and runs! Fuller and into the pads, Samuels goes for an off drive but gets an inside edge on it. The ball beats the short fine leg fielder and the ball races away to the fence. 50-run stand comes up for Marlon Samuels and Evin Lewis.
Lewis drives it through covers for a single.
Samuels drives it towards point for a single.
SIX! Payback time for Samuels! Good length delivery outside off, Samuels backs away and carves it over the cover region for half a dozen.
FOUR! Again wide outside off, Samuels throws his bat at it. Gets a thick outside edge over the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Short delivery into the batsman, Samuels goes for the pull but misses.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
Lewis makes room again. This time Jadeja slants it across him. Evin can't do anything about it and leaves it alone. Clever stuff. Just a couple of runs from it.
Wide! Lewis makes room. Jadeja tries to follow him but gets his line completely wrong. Fires it way outside leg. Evin leaves it and a wide is signalled.
Jadeja fires it quicker on the pads. Lewis goes for the pull shot but misses and gets rapped on the pads. Jadeja appeals but it's turned down.
On the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Served outside off, flayed to point.
Flatter outside off, chopped into the pads.
Ravindra Jadeja is called into the attack.

SIX! A good end to the over by Lewis! Full down the leg side. Lewis kneels down and slog sweeps it over backward square leg. It's hit flat and off the meat. Goes the distance for a maximum. Spoils the over for Kuldeep.
Beaten! Served around off, spins away sharply. Evin fails to pick it and is beaten all ends up.
Wide! Tossed up wide outside off, spinning away. It's way wide and Lewis leaves it alone and gets a wide.
On the pads, nudged down to fine leg for a single.
Lewis stays in the crease and places it in the wide mid on region for a single.
Wide! Kuldeep fires it down the leg side. Evin shimmies across a touch to work it across the line but misses. A wide is signalled but good variation from the chinaman.

How did that not hit the stumps? Served outside leg, spinning towards the stumps. Lewis kneels down the sweep but misses it completely. Is lucky as the ball bounces more and goes from over the stumps. Superb ball, this. Kuldeep is really unlucky!
Tossed up on middle, spinning away, pushed with ease through covers for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav is back into the attack.
Full around leg, driven past the stumps at the bowler's end to long on. A single is taken.
Full outside off, Lewis carves it through cover-point for a single.
Shami fires it into the batsman. Cramps him for room and raps Lewis on the pads as he fails to flick it. Good delivery, this!
Full outside off, driven to extra cover. No runs taken.
Wide! Full again but slightly down the leg side. Lewis gets inside the line and looks to clip it away but misses. A wide is signalled.
Full outside off, Lewis clears his front leg and drills it hard through wide mid off. Kohli in the deep, hares to his right and makes a good stop near the fence. A brace is taken.
Kohli is having a chat with the bowler now.

SIX! Welcome back, Mohammed Shami! Bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, angling into the batsman. Lewis gets into the position early and hammers it over cow corner for a maximum. That was a brutal hit. 100 up for West Indies as well. They need 90 runs more off 59 balls.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
Bowls a genuine leg spinner around off this time, Samuels tries to chop but fails to make contact.
Tossed up outside off, Lewis dabs it towards short third man for a single.
Fuller into the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated outside off, Lewis shuffles way across, adjusts to the flight and clips it through the square leg region for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Lewis fails to cut this time.
SIX! You don't bowl those to Lewis! High full toss outside off, Lewis stays in his crease and smashes that straight over the long off region for half a dozen.
Lewis camps back and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Samuels clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Wide! Sprayed quicker and down the leg side, Samuels tries to clip it on the leg side but fails to make contact. The players appeal but the umpire spreads his arms to signal it as a wide.
Samuels gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
A slip in place for Samuels.
Leg bye! Sprayed into the pads, Lewis tries to clip it on the leg side. Kisses the pads and the ball goes towards the short fine leg region for a leg bye.
Marlon Samuels is the new man in.

OUT! Dhoni makes no mistake! Bowls a leg spinner around middle and leg, Gayle tries to go big this time. Gets a top edge on it and the ball balloons towards the silly point region. Dhoni calls for it and takes it nicely. Kuldeep Yadav has drawn first blood of the encounter and the Indians are really excited.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

NOT OUT! Tosses this outside off, Lewis tries to slog it on the leg side. Fails to make contact and the ball goes through to the keeper. Dhoni collects the ball and flicks the bails off. He appeals and the umpire goes upstairs to check for it. Replays show that the batsmen had his leg inside the line.
Lewis has swung and miss, Dhoni has collected the ball quickly, taken the bails off and appealed for stumping. Lewis looks safe though!
FOUR! Lewis is meaning business! Fuller outside off, Lewis drills that hard through the wide mid off region for a boundary.
Shorter in line of the stumps, Gayle pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, Gayle cuts it straight towards the fielder at point.
Fires this one into the pads, Gayle steps out to it and tries to go hard at it. Fails to make contact and gets rapped on the pads.
Lewis punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Wide! Bowls this wide outside off, the batsmen is undisturbed. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Fires this full outside off, Gayle tries to hit it but fails to make contact.

Lewis is living a charmed life! Tossed up outside off, Lewis again goes for a big shot. Mistimes it towards the wide long off region. Karthik runs across from long off, gets underneath it but fails to hold onto it. Another chance goes down and Lewis survives. The batsmen run a single.
Lewis cuts it through the point region for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

SIX! Lewis is welcoming every new bowler in style! Does not spare Kuldeep who bowls it fuller outside off, Lewis smashes that over the long on region for a biggie. Gets to his fifty with this! He is playing a superb knock!
Ends of mandatory Powerplay and Kuldeep Yadav comes onto bowl.

Dropped! How costly will that turn out to be? Length delivery outside off, Lewis makes room and tries to go for a biggie. Mistimes it and gets it off the top edge. The ball balloons in the mid on region. Kohli comes charging in from long on and Shami comes from mid off. Shami gets a hand to it but collides with Kohli to drop it. The batsmen run a single.
Evin Lewis is inching closer to his half century.
FOUR! Lewis, you beauty! Length delivery outside off, Lewis stays in his crease and slaps that over the cover fielder for a boundary.
SIX! That's gone into the orbit! Short in line of the stumps, Lewis backs away and smashes that over the long on region for a 93 meter maximum.
Again into the pads, Gayle flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Gayle heaves it towards long on for a single.
Length delivery into the pads, Gayle clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Now, change of ends for Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
Again full into the pads, drilled towards long on. No runs taken.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
Fuller into the pads, Lewis clips it straight towards mid on.
SIX! Fetch that, Ashwin! Fuller in line of the stumps, Lewis just stays in his crease and whacks that straight over the bowler for half a dozen. Ashwin is getting hit all round the park.
SIX! Lewis, is the man! Short into the stumps, Lewis camps back and smokes that over the mid on boundary for a biggie.
Before this over, a long chat took place between Dhoni and Kohli.
Sliding down the leg side, Lewis flicks it through the square leg region for a couple.
Sprayed into the pads, Gayle clips it towards wide mid on for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on from the other end.
FOUR! Pierced! Fuller outside off, Lewis carves it through the gap between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
FOUR! Lewis is stamping authority there! Length delivery outside off, Lewis smacks that with brute force through the extra-cover region for a boundary.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Lewis flashes hard at it. Gets an outside edge to it and the ball flies over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, punched through the point region. Jadeja gives it a chase and keeps it down to a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, pushed towards cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Gayle welcomes Shami in style! Mohammed bowls a fuller delivery outside off, Gayle just waits for it and smashes that straight over the mid on region for a boundary.
Mohammed Shami is called in for a bowl.
Good length delivery around leg, Lewis makes room and only manages to punch it towards the fielder at covers.
Angling into the pads, Lewis clips it through the backward square leg region for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Lewis defends it on the off side.
Mid-wicket goes back.
Short delivery into the batsman, Lewis sways away from the bouncer.

Run out chance missed! Into the hips, Gayle clips it towards square leg. Calls for a quick single and Dhawan rushes towards the ball. He has a shy at the non-striker's end but he fails to score a direct hit. Gayle was the man in danger who is lucky to survive there. A single taken.
Short delivery into the batsman, pulled towards deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Gayle finally makes contact and he does make it count! Tossed up outside off, Gayle gets forward and thumps it over the mid off region for half a dozen.
A bit short around off, Gayle defends it on the off side.
Clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Around middle and leg, Lewis goes for the sweep. Manages to get an inside onto the pads on the leg side for a single.
Mid-wicket goes back and square leg comes in for Lewis.

That was close! Floats this one outside off, Gayle goes for the big shot. Misses it completely and the ball whizzes past the off pole. Dhoni fails to collect it and the ball rolls through his legs for a bye. Had Dhoni collected it, Gayle would have been stumped as well.
Fuller around off, Gayle gets ahead and defends it.
Ravichandran Ashwin to share the new ball. A slip in place for him...
Good length delivery around off, pushed towards mid off.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Gayle flicks it towards short fine leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, defended with soft hands towards point for a quick single.
Angling into the hips, Lewis tries to tuck it on the leg side. Fails to make contact and gets rapped on the thigh pad.

Good length delivery around leg, Lewis camps back and pulls it through the square leg region. Hits into the breeze so the ball does not carry over the ropes. The ball sticks into the surface as it lands. Stops before the fence and the batsmen run a couple.
Starts by bowling a length delivery into the pads, Gayle clips it towards fine leg for a single to get off the mark.

Welcome back for the chase! The players and umpires are out in the middle. Chris Gayle and Evin Lewis to open the batting for West Indies. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start the proceedings with the new ball for India. Here we go...
